extracted.name: Barbequed Cabbage
extracted.description: These cabbage stuffed foil packets are cooked on the grill in this recipe, but can easily be cooked in the gently coals of a campfire. This is a delicious way to use up some cabbage and turn someone into a cabbage lover at the same time!
ingredient_lines: 0.5 head cabbage, cut into thick shreds
instruction_lines: Preheat an outdoor grill for medium heat.

Divide cabbage among 4 squares of aluminum foil. Sprinkle 2 tablespoons soy sauce over each cabbage mound; place 1 tablespoon butter on top. Season with pepper. Fold the sides of the foil over cabbage, sealing to form a packet.
Place packets onto preheated grill; cook until cabbage tender, 15 to 20 minutes.
